effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Level 5 or lower Digimon. For every 2 cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards, add 1 to the maximum level of the Digimon you can choose with this effect.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞. Then, place 1 Digimon card with ＜Save＞ in its text from your trash under 1 of your Tamers.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon has ＜Save＞ in its text, it gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
